comment: Single source of truth for the refusal code the API returns when an agent re-raises an approval a person rejected in the same thread with nobody asking since (#2885). POST /approvals answers 409 with detail {code, message, approval_id, rejected_by, rejected_at} (apps/api/src/curie_api/routers/approvals.py). The worker's approval client treats that code, and only that code, as a terminal refusal whose message it posts to the thread instead of escalating (apps/worker/src/curie_worker/approvals.py). The two lanes cannot share code, so the literal is frozen here: changing one side without this file fails that side's test. Read by apps/api/tests/test_approvals.py::test_reraise_refusal_code_matches_the_frozen_vector and by apps/worker/tests/kernel/test_approval_lifecycle.py::test_rejected_reraise_409_is_a_terminal_refusal. Both lanes reject unknown top-level keys so a key one lane cannot see cannot pass vacuously.
